# Documentation issue

> Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](documentation.vi.md)

## Location

Which README, guide, notebook section, API description, or community document is affected?

## Problem

What is unclear, missing, inconsistent, or outdated?

## Suggested change

Describe the wording, structure, example, or cross-link that would improve it.

## Language pair

If the affected document has an English/Vietnamese pair, identify both files so they can be updated together.
